name: RobustAPI
description: RobustAPI is a dataset designed to evaluate the reliability and robustness of code generated by large language models, focusing on common API misuse patterns in real-world software development. It contains 1208 coding questions from Stack Overflow covering 18 representative Java APIs.
reputation: A niche benchmark used in research on API misuse and robustness of LLM-generated code, with limited but relevant adoption in code generation evaluation.
notes: Highlights that even state-of-the-art models like GPT-4 generate code with significant API misuse; focuses on real-world coding help scenarios.
